comment: Accepted gaps of the syscall trace conformance matrix. Each entry names a syscall, a gap kind (no_decoder: the recorder has no decoder for a pointer argument and records an explicit NO_DECODER field; not_captured: the program passed data the recorder does not capture; render: the Syscall Trace view cannot name a value) and why it is accepted. 'unexercised' lists slots no fixture case reaches, with the reason. A gap or an unexercised slot missing here fails the suite.

undescribed.reason: The recorder copies user memory without faulting (contract 15.1). An input on a page the program has mapped but not touched yet (a forked child's literal, static glibc's start-up readlinkat of /proc/self/exe, an untouched mapping) is recorded NOT_RESIDENT at entry and, since series 0053, read again at exit (contract section 22), where the call has usually faulted it in; the host then shows it complete and marked. What remains NOT_RESIDENT is memory the call itself never read (a buffer /dev/null's write ignores, a call that failed before reading), a ninth or later such input of one call, and the argument strings of a successful interpreter (script) exec, whose argument list the kernel rewrote. In the 0053 runs only one call per stress run is left: ant-workload's deliberately oversized execve, which fails with E2BIG while the kernel copies the strings from the last one, before it reaches the forked child's literal argv[1].
